summary: DOE conditionally commits to a 30-year federal loan of up to $5B for uprates at eight Constellation nuclear plants in Illinois, Maryland and Pennsylvania.
notes: Conditional: no loan agreement is signed and nothing is drawn, so the status stays announced. Per the 8-K, DOE's Office of Energy Dominance Financing would guarantee a loan from the Federal Financing Bank at 0.375% over Treasuries; both are US government, so it is one loan edge, not a guarantee. The plants are Braidwood, Byron, Clinton, Dresden, LaSalle, Quad Cities, Calvert Cliffs and Limerick.
